hits.snippet: NetBrain Technologies has secured a majority investment from Blackstone Growth in a deal valuing the AI-powered network automation company at $750 million, coinciding with a leadership transition as founder Lingping Gao steps down as CEO to become chair of the board. Bernadette Nixon, formerly CEO of Algolia, has been named CEO and joined the board, bringing extensive experience scaling enterprise software companies. Founded in 2004, NetBrain provides intent-based network automation solutions to more than a third of Fortune 500 companies, and the new funding is aimed at accelerating its global expansion and advancing its AI-driven network automation capabilities.
